name: Chundikkulam National Park
description: Chundikkulam National Park, nestled in the Kilinochchi district, offers visitors a chance to explore diverse ecosystems through bird watching trails and nature walks. The park, established as a nature reserve, provides a sanctuary for numerous bird species and other wildlife, making it a popular spot for nature enthusiasts and photographers. Its establishment was part of efforts to preserve Sri Lanka's rich biodiversity amidst ongoing challenges. Visitors can expect to see a variety of local flora and fauna, including migratory birds during certain times of the year.
